text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believes that Grass Wonder
rejects scouting offers because
she lacks
the drive to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the racer I saw training doesn't look
like someone who's simply
quiet and
gentle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to know the true Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Good evening. What are you doing
here at this late hour?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I... Well,
I lost track of time looking up at
the night sky. Hehe, how
silly of me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I should return to the dormitory
now...
Was there anything you
needed of me? If
not, then good night—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that...
I believe I've explained before
that I'd refuse...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A terrible shame though it may be, my
mind is unchanged. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well... Forgive me, but it's a personal
matter... That's all I can say.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem to want to explain, but I
can still try to work the
answer out for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So I think back to that look in her
eyes on
the course, the blue flames
I saw hidden
within. How she really feels...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What drew you to that conclusion?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My eyes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You understood that... just from my eyes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A Yamato Nadeshiko is always modest—a
soft expression coupled with a calm
demeanor. She must always remain
unflappable and
solemn.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That is the ideal to which I strive,
but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I must confess, true serenity still eludes
me. The anger I feel toward
my own
weakness is not so easy to quell.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I decided to run of my own volition. The path I mean to master lies on the turf. And to reach its end, to win, I cannot afford to stop running.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... I should never have relinquished my
hold on victory... no matter
what the
course of events.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And yet!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The moment I begin to yield, the path to
victory will crumble. In such
a halfhearted
state, I cannot in good conscience accept
any offer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Put more plainly, I'm being selfish. It is
simply my preference.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My apologies, but I should leave—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Again? You mean to say, you intend on
trying to scout me again?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You'll wait for months until I race in the
next tryouts?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How do I put this? Surely you can see I
am... not the easiest racer to
deal with.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I never compromise, and once I've made a
decision, I never change
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because I was dissatisfied with my
results,
I've refused every offer just
so I can take
on the tryouts one more time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing that, do you mean what you
say? You will wait for me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, are you absolutely sure? You do
realize that should I keep
failing to
achieve victory, you'll be left without a
student to train?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, how remarkable. What can I say to
that? Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see you are skilled at motivating me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, several months later...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's going for it! She easily
overtakes the lead and jumps
to first!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's ahead! What an astounding push!
She's left the pack
behind—Grass Wonder
takes first plaaace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder remains determined all the
way up to her beautiful
finish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You got first, Graaass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm rather taken aback.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What a huge lie! You can't fool me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, now you can debut with a clear
conscience, right? Races are
gonna be so
much hotter! Burning hot! Scorching!
Mucho calienteee!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Congrats,
Grass! I'm so excited for the day
we race together!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I look forward to it as well, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After responding to her rivals' words
with a
warm smile, Grass Wonder
approaches me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe... yes. I've been waiting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I should formally introduce myself... My
name is Grass Wonder. I hope
for your full
guidance and support.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please help me traverse the path I walk to
its end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus begin my days with the unwavering
racer, Grass Wonder!
